init_attention_kv_cache: build a python module that initializes a Gemma3n KV cache with given batch size, cache size, num heads, and head dim
encode_tokens_with_embedder: build a python module that encodes input token IDs into embeddings using the Gemma3n Embedder with a given vocab size and embed dim
decode_embeddings_with_embedder: build a python module that decodes embedding vectors back to logit space using the Gemma3n Embedder decode method
apply_feedforward_mlp: build a python module that applies the Gemma3n FeedForward MLP layer with gated GeLU activation to an input sequence
run_transformer_block: build a python module that runs a single Gemma3n transformer Block with attention, MLP, and optional AltUp or Laurel sub-modules
